question: An increase in the concentration of acetyl-CoA derived from beta-oxidation promotes:

options.opa: Hepatic synthesis of acetoacetate and betahydroxybutyrate.
options.opb: The activation of lipolysis by activation of hormone-sensitive lipase.
options.opc: Inhibition of hepatic synthesis of cholesterol.
options.opd: Mitochondrial inhibition of the citric acid cycle.
